tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground on landing and app. Same as shadcn neutral.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on background, card and muted. Also the line of the share price chart and the fill of limit meters.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Card and panel surface. In light it equals background, so cards are set apart by the border token.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, tooltips, dialogs, sheets.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one primary button per view: black in light, white in dark.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on primary.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Label on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: neutral status chips, meter tracks, skeletons, code inline.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, table headers, timestamps. 4.7:1 on background in light, 7:1 or more on background, card and muted in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and selected row fill for ghost buttons, tabs and table rows.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Not for control boundaries, which use input.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Boundary of inputs, selects and outline buttons. At least 3:1 on background and card in both themes, darker than shadcn's default on purpose.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px with a 2px offset. At least 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status text and dot for Executed, Pass, Live, SUCCESS. 5:1 on background and success-bg in light, 8:1 or more in dark. Always next to a word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Chip and banner fill behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status text and dot for Stuck, Skip, Reversed, Rejected, INCOMPLETE_DEPOSIT, REFUNDED; the near-limit meter fill; the stuck panel border. Always next to a word.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Chip and panel fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status text and dot for Failed, Fail, Halted, FAILED; field errors. 6:1 on background in light, 7:1 in dark. Always next to a word.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Chip and banner fill behind danger text, the Halted banner.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: shadcn's destructive slot, aliased to danger so the system has one red.

tokens.name: terminal-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal surface. Dark in both themes so commands read as commands.

tokens.name: terminal-fg
tokens.usage: Command and output text on terminal-bg.

tokens.name: terminal-muted
tokens.usage: Prompt sign, labels and the block label on terminal-bg. 7:1 or more.

tokens.name: terminal-success
tokens.usage: Check marks on terminal-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: terminal-border
tokens.usage: Divider under the terminal title bar.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero headline only. 56px under 768px wide.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Landing closing line and page heroes on /proof and /trust.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: App page titles and card group titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A USDC vault on NEAR. A sealed strategy trades it, the contract enforces the limits, and you can leave without us.
styles.usage: Landing running text, at most 65 characters a line.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Shares mint at the next cycle, so a wrong price cannot dilute holders.
styles.usage: App text, form help, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Stat labels, table headers, chip text.

styles.name: mono-stat
styles.usage: Stat values: book, share price, counts.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Commands, terminal output, hashes, account IDs, amounts in tables.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Truncated hashes in dense rows and chips.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Gaps between siblings use these steps; sections on the landing use space-24.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, the page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, app header padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between app sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between landing blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing section padding top and bottom (64px on phones).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status chips, inline code, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, terminal, banners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and meter tracks only.

shadow.note: Flat by default. Only floating layers get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, tooltips, dialogs, sheets. Never on cards.
